meta.title: H100 SXM · 132 SM 数据流沙盘
meta.description: 可重播的教学性离散事件模型：分区内L2共享输入合并、独立HBM home、跨分区桥、逐跳串行化/传播分离、SM计算与写回。参数化周期不是GPU实测或cycle-accurate结果。

topology.routing: SM → local logical router → local crossbar → local L2; miss → home HBM, directed bridge if remote
topology.partitionMapping: ordinal halves are a teaching assignment, not a recovered NVIDIA GPC/L2/HBM physical mapping

nocModel.evidence: H100-inspired topology; teaching routing/timing, not recovered physical netlist
nocModel.l2Service: pipelined fixed lookup/write latency; serializer occupancy = ceil(bytes/l2BytesPerCycle)
nocModel.hbmService: nonpipelined single-server teaching endpoint; hbmLatency + ceil(bytes/hbmBytesPerCycle)
nocModel.latencyCalibration: none; published total L2 RTT is not assigned to every hop
nocModel.cachePolicy: ideal whole-tile shared-input cache and pending merge keyed by local bank and data key; no sector/MSHR limit

assumptions: 132 SM、5 HBM3堆栈参考H100 SXM；自定义SM数时为教学架构变体。默认8逻辑路由组、8 L2 bank是教学聚合端点，本运行数量以config为准；不是物理GPC/80个L2 slice/真实控制器数量。双partition的ordinal分半是教学映射，不是NVIDIA物理netlist。
每SM固定分配每轮一个tile，并给该任务一个唯一逻辑CTA编号用于界面归属；shared与private输入全部返回后才能计算，写回HBM后开始下一轮。不模拟真实CTA调度、指令、warp或GEMM数值。
partitioned-crossbar下请求选择本partition内L2 bank；shared缓存/pending按(bankId,dataKey)合并，各partition独立fill；HBMhome由dataKey独立hash，远端miss经bridge。uniform-star保留单fabric全芯片key映射。返回逐目标单播，这不是HBM原生广播或硬件NoC multicast。
L2仅缓存共享tile（本工作负载内无驱逐），私有输入为首次读取。tile传输为整包，不模拟cache line、coalescing或一致性协议。
有向NoC链路是单注入FCFS serializer；传播中的包不阻塞下一包注入。L2 lookup/writeback按序接收、固定latency可在途重叠；HBM端点仍为单服务非流水粗模型，未校准真实DRAM时序。所有排队在实际到达时发生，fabric是理想非阻塞交叉开关。
NoC每跳占用ceil(bytes/bytesPerCycle)，尾包到达再加latencyCycles；下跳等尾包才启动，是packet store-and-forward而非flit/wormhole。issueReleaseCycle保留串行化释放点，完成依赖仍等真实尾包到达。
默认8×256 B/cycle与5×128 B/cycle的3.2倍是名义端口budget参数层级；非流水HBM端点不能据此声称达到真实峰值或拟合MICRO论文。总L2 RTT绝不直接当每hop延迟。
等待队列无界；本版未模拟有限buffer、credit/backpressure、丢包或死锁；HBM写提交通知为零开销控制事件，不单独模拟ACK包。带宽、延迟与计算周期是可编辑教学参数，不是NVIDIA硬件校准值。
